title: zazzle run component diagram
description: The runner starts the command and renders its output through a profile and then clean's steps, and stores the result with the raw output for read-again. The command itself is whatever the caller names.

components.name: zazzle run
components.responsibility: Runs one command and prints its output cleaned, with its exit code.

components.name: Runner (mod.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses the options, runs the command with one merged output pipe (at most 64 MiB kept) and a timeout, and renders the output with a footer; tags it with an output id when it is stored.

components.name: Profiles (profile.rs)
components.responsibility: Per-tool rules that drop and count known noise, drop repeats, or group diagnostics under their file; detection from the command line.

components.name: clean's steps
components.responsibility: tidy_lines before the profile; shrink_steps and cuts after it; store to keep the result and the raw output under an id.

components.name: Output store
components.responsibility: outputs.rs in the parent folder: keeps the result and the raw output for an hour for read-again.

components.name: The wrapped command
components.responsibility: Any program the caller names, such as cargo test or dotnet build, run as a child with the caller's environment and standard input.

relationships.description: Spawns it with stdout and stderr on one pipe; kills it after the timeout.
clean::tidy_lines before the profile, clean::shrink_steps and cuts after it, and clean::store for the stored output.
outputs::dir: the store directory, from the caller's environment.
